bind_address.description: IP address to bind the web server to.

web_port.description: TCP port for the main web API and UI.

log_level.description: Log level (debug, info, warning, error, critical).

use_ssl.description: Enable TLS/SSL encryption for the web interface.

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate file.

ssl_key_path.description: Path to the SSL private key file.

db_host.description: Hostname or IP address of PostgreSQL server.
